classes.name: results
classes.reason: probe.write_staged does os.write followed by os.fsync before returning, so the rank stops until the data is durable, and because every generation is bracketed by barrier.wait() (with release measured as sum(max(times))) all ranks are held until the slowest rank's staged writes finish.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: probe.write_buffered opens, writes and closes with no fsync and its timing is never recorded, so the flush is left to the kernel and overlapped, but it still occurs inside the barrier-delimited generation loop that holds every rank at barrier.wait() until the generation ends.
